title: Fast KVzip: Efficient and Accurate LLM Inference with Gated KV Eviction
abstract: arXiv:2601.17668v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficient key-value (KV) cache management is crucial for the practical deployment of large language models (LLMs), yet existing compression techniques often incur a trade-off between performance degradation and computational overhead. We propose a novel gating-based KV cache eviction method for frozen-weight LLMs that achieves high compression ratios with negligible computational cost. Our approach introduces lightweight sink-attention gating modules to identify and retain critical KV pairs, and integrates seamlessly into both the prefill and decoding stages. The proposed gate training algorithm relies on forward passes of an LLM, avoiding expensive backpropagation, while achieving strong task generalization through a task-agnostic reconstruction objective. Extensive experiments across the Qwen2.5-1M, Qwen3, and Gemma3 families show that our method maintains near-lossless performance while evicting up to 70% of the KV cache. Th

translated_title: Fast KVzip：基于门控KV驱逐的高效且精确的大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 高效的键值缓存管理对于大语言模型的实际部署至关重要，然而现有的压缩技术往往在性能下降与计算开销之间存在权衡。我们提出了一种新颖的基于门控的KV缓存驱逐方法，适用于冻结权重的大语言模型，能够在可忽略的计算成本下实现高压缩率。我们的方法引入了轻量级的sink-attention门控模块来识别并保留关键的KV对，并无缝集成到预填充和解码两个阶段中。所提出的门控训练算法仅依赖大语言模型的前向传播，避免了昂贵的反向传播，同时通过任务无关的重构目标实现了强大的任务泛化能力。在Qwen2.5-1M、Qwen3和Gemma3模型系列上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在驱逐高达70%的KV缓存的同时保持了近乎无损的性能。
tldr: 提出了一种基于门控的KV缓存驱逐方法，利用轻量级sink-attention门控模块和仅需前向传播的训练算法，在计算成本几乎可忽略的情况下驱逐高达70%的KV缓存，同时保持近乎无损的推理性能。
en_tdlr: A gating-based KV cache eviction method with lightweight sink-attention gate modules trained via forward passes only, achieving up to 70% KV cache eviction with near-lossless performance at negligible computational cost.
